purpose: First end-to-end training run on real data in this repo. Validates the full pipeline and produces the problem statement's mandatory logistic-regression comparison. NOT a substitute for CIC-IDS-2018: CTU-13 here is binary and has one label transition.

mandatory_baseline_comparison.finding: Sequence information is worth +0.159, but the LSTM adds only +0.005 over logistic regression on the flattened window. On CIC-IDS-2018 the LSTM was worth +0.180 over the same baseline. CTU-13 binary botnet detection is near-degenerate: it has no pre-compromise baseline, so every infected-host window is labelled attack and a linear model on the raw window solves it. Any team reporting a high CTU-13 number is reporting an easy task, and this run is the evidence.

world_model_state_head.verdict: PARTIAL: beats persistence but LOSES to the window mean. The state head predicts a smoothed central estimate of the window, not its trajectory. Do not describe this as learned dynamics without stating this.
world_model_state_head.finding: The state head beats copying the last flow (+0.425 skill) so it is not merely echoing its input, but it LOSES to averaging the window (-0.090). It has learned a smoothed central estimate, not a trajectory. K-step drift is nearly flat (0.974 -> 1.019 over 10 steps) and predicted-stage volatility across the rollout is 0.0001, meaning the free-running simulation reaches a fixed point almost immediately instead of evolving. The rollout is real code on real weights, but on this corpus it does not simulate a trajectory.

calibration.finding: Already calibrated (ECE 0.0008) because the task is trivially easy -- 99.9% accurate at 99.98% confidence is well calibrated. Temperature scaling has nothing to fix here and slightly worsens it. The machinery is verified by calibration.py --self-check, which corrects genuine overconfidence 0.280 -> 0.010.

transition_eval.reason: 0 transition windows in the validation split. The corpus is two concatenated captures, so it contains exactly 1 label transition and it falls in train or is purged at a block edge. transition_eval.py refuses rather than reporting a number.

onset_head.reason: 1 label transition in 92,152 windows means onset labels are degenerate (positive rate 1.1e-05 at k=1) and AUC is undefined. train_v2 detected this and fell back to macro_f1 selection. The onset head needs CIC-IDS-2018 or DAPT 2020.
